Thought: Now I'll create the LAMMPS input script for NVT equilibration. The script will:
1. Set up the simulation with metal units and atomic style
2. Read the structure file
3. Replicate the system 5x5x5
4. Set up the EAM potential
5. Run NVT equilibration at 300K for 10000 steps
Action: write_file
Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/melting/brief/subtasks/aluminum_nvt_subtask_melting_trial_4/in.nvt", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Al NVT equilibration

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read initial structure
read_data Al_structure.data

# Replicate system
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Initialize velocities
velocity all create 300.0 4928459 dist gaussian

# Define compute for temperature and pressure
compute myTemp all temp
compute myPress all pressure myTemp

# NVT equilibration
fix 1 all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1
timestep 0.001

# Output settings
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe ke etotal press density

# Run NVT
run 10000

# Write final structure
write_data Al_nvt_final.data

# Print final density
variable dens equal density
print "Final density = ${dens}""}
